name: commit-changes
title_zh: 只挑你动过的文件进提交，别把无关改动卷进来
tagline_zh: 工作区里混着别人的改动？它按你动过的文件精确暂存，生成 Conventional Commit 标题和详细正文。
tagline_en: Mixed worktree? It stages only files you touched, writes a scoped Conventional Commit with a full body, and shows.
desc_en: Prepare and create PlainTab git commits with scoped Conventional Commit subjects and detailed commit bodies. Use when the user asks to commit, 提交, create a git commit, stage changes, or asks for precise Conventional Commits / Google-style commit messages; especially when the worktree may contain unrelated user changes.
why_zh: 别的提交工具一股脑 git add -A，它靠 diff 识别你的改动边界，把无关文件挡在门外。
why_en: Unlike blanket git add -A, it diffs to find your changes, keeps unrelated files out, and writes Google-style commit bodies.
limit_zh: 只认 PlainTab 仓库的 git 工作区；不处理未跟踪的新文件，也不支持 amend。
limit_en: PlainTab repo only; no untracked files, no amend/push/rebase—it stops after the commit, you handle the rest.
title_en: Commit only your changes, leave unrelated edits alone
